howTo: On the box: cd /workspace/mll-audit/ref/mutinynet-cli && cargo build --release && ./target/release/mutinynet-cli login and approve the GitHub device code it prints, at github.com/login/device.
The token is saved to ~/.mutinynet/token (valid 31 days). /workspace/mutinynet/autopilot.sh then funds the node, opens channels and starts otsd and OP-RETURN-Bot.
Run: npx tsx scripts/mutinynet-anchor.mts (stamps and revokes on Mutinynet and records txids here).
